summary: Implemented `in` membership in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test via ref.startswith(self), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when ref equals a stored term URI under node-type-aware equality (inherited by _RDFNamespace). Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix membership, SH, RDFS (positive, non-defined term, plain string and Literal negatives), and RDF. Nothing was run, per instructions; verification was by reading the code only, so the doctests and existing tests remain unverified. No commits made.
